author: Sofian Maabout
html: Nowadays, every tier in scientific publication is suspect: authors are suspected of plagiarism, multiple submissions of the same work, … reviewers are suspected of favoring the authors they know or disadvantaging those they hate, … publishers are suspected to be just industrials making a lot of money…It is a pity to observe this trend and the required machinery (double blind reviews, automatic plagiarism checking, …) used to face it. Are all these efforts worthwhile? Is scientific publication healthier than what is was a few years ago?
